newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Estonia's PM Vahi arrives for Singapore visit.
newsitem.headline: Estonia's PM Vahi arrives for Singapore visit.

text.p: Estonia 's Prime Minister Tiit Vahi arrived in Singapore for a four-day working visit on Saturday.

A statement from Singapore's Ministry of Foreign Affairs said Vahi would be accompanied by Estonia's Minister for Economic Affairs, Tiiu Aro, officials from its foreign affairs and economic ministries and a business delegation.
The statement said Vahi would meet with Singapore Prime Minister Goh Chok Tong and a dinner would be hosted in honour of the visit.
Vahi is also scheduled to speak at a business seminar on Monday on business opportunities in Estonia, organised by the Export Institute of Singapore.
